_comment: Pure-PGO sphere size sweep (g2o create_sphere, no landmarks). Generate the data first with: python3 examples/sphere_sweep.py generate --axis pgo
_comment_max_dense_gb: 32 GB = attempt Dense on every dataset that physically can run. pgo_20k needs 28.8 GB and fits in the 53 GB available; pgo_30k (64.8 GB) and pgo_50k (180 GB) exceed total system RAM (62 GB, 1 GB swap), so they are recorded as dense_too_large with the size they would have required rather than OOM-killing the sweep process.
